ARCHITECTURE.label: CHAPTER 02 — THE HERITAGE · AHOM LEGACY
title: CARVED BY AHOMS,
BLESSED BY KAMAKHYA
ARCHITECTURE.alt: Kamakhya Temple complex on Nilachal Hill glowing in morning light
ARCHITECTURE.detailAlt: Assorted traditional Jaapi hats of Dhemaji, Assam
paragraphs: Six hundred years of Ahom glory. Rang Ghar, Talatal Ghar, Kareng — Asia's oldest amphitheatre of kings.
The estate unfolds like a satra courtyard — each threshold revealing bamboo, water, jaapi and sky, just as Srimanta Sankardev imagined.

DINING.label: CHAPTER 03 — THE TABLE · AXOMIYA PAAT
title: A FEAST SERVED
ON BANANA & BELL-METAL
DINING.body: From sour Masor Tenga to silky Khar, duck with bamboo shoot and til-pitha — recipes from Ahom kitchens and satra refectories, served on kahor bell-metal.
menuHighlights: Haanh with bamboo shoot, Ahom duck curry
